module_role: Explicit source-table application scopes for the 75 published M-801 through M-804 point-list rows. Each remains a literal source occurrence rather than a projected hardware I/O count.

applications.ownership_scope: Published M-801 template stated typical for each VFD; no individual VFD asset is assigned by this matrix.
Published AHU-1 DDC point-list rows; repeated printed AI3 is retained and no controller terminal owner is inferred.
Published chilled-water-plant DDC rows for the source plant context; no final physical I/O/card or per-pump expansion is inferred.
Published AHU-2 DDC point-list rows; repeated printed AI4 and BI2 are retained.
Published laboratory-exhaust-fan source matrix for EF-1, EF-2 and EF-3 context; no one-row-per-fan expansion is invented.
Published scheduled-exhaust source matrix for EF-5 and EF-6 context; the rows are not duplicated per fan.
Published electric-unit-heater DDC source rows, including repeated BI1 labels; no equipment-tag mapping is printed.
Published VAV terminal DDC source rows; these do not establish a one-row-per-scheduled-VAV physical point count.

expanded_count_warning: 75 is the count of literal published point-list rows, including repeated identifiers and typical matrices. It is not an installed BAS point, controller-card, terminal, wiring, device or VFD total.
